question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

A dummy used to display clothes in a shop window
solution:
The correct answer is 'Mannequin'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The one-word substitute for the given group of words is 'Mannequin.'
 
• The marked option Mannequin means a model of a human body used for displaying clothes in shop windows.
 
 
• Example:That mannequin outside that clothing store looked so real to me.
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is option 1.
